intent.raw: Define, design and plan a new package for the verified OEW UX/UI change requests.
intent.objective: Author and validate a private candidate package for profile-driven OEW semantic navigation with Body War as the first frozen profile, without implementation or authority mutation.

steps.name: Bind verified findings, frozen Body War inputs, Inventory readiness and live OEW seams
stop_conditions: Stop if Inventory lookup readiness is blocked.
Stop before treating Inventory or review evidence as ontology authority.

steps.name: Define the reusable semantic-navigation core and replaceable profile boundary
stop_conditions: Stop if presentation is allowed to create ontology membership, branch or authority.
Stop if Body War vocabulary becomes reusable-core authority.

steps.name: Author six-view architecture, UX, validation contracts and deterministic selection
stop_conditions: Stop on any Design selection diagnostic or changed second pass.
Stop if a required extension is missing.
Do not count planned witnesses as Plan evidence.

steps.name: Author high-complexity layering, split tasks, atomic SWUs and closeout contracts
stop_conditions: Keep candidate first-unit selection blocked while OD-04 remains pending; scope OD-01 through OD-03 only to their declared later consumers.
Stop on a task-shaped SWU or missing closeout row.

steps.name: Validate SWU atomicity, first-unit narrowness, recomposition and hidden gaps
stop_conditions: Stop mutation handoff on Distill block.
Stop on hidden glue, task-shaped units or incomplete navigation.
Do not let Distill resolve project-owner choices.

steps.name: Route the acceptance-critical project choices before Task Session

outputs.ref: Scoped owner answers for OD-01 through OD-04

stop_conditions: This authored route does not answer the decisions.
No SWU is selected before its exact scoped decision inputs and Refresh revalidation; SWU-OEWSN-004 requires OD-04 only.
Task Session independently owns later preflight and mutation.

gates.condition: All authoring obligations map to exact current sources and Inventory readiness passes.
Scope, denominator, total ownership, required outputs and two-pass fixed point pass.
High-complexity layering, task details, atomic SWUs, validation and closeout contracts are complete.
Units close and recompose with clear first-unit navigation and no hidden acceptance-critical gap.
Each selected SWU's required decision inputs from OD-01 through OD-04 are exact and frozen; unrelated pending choices do not block the unit.
Plan approval, profile approval and Task Session mutation admission remain distinct.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The route authors one coherent package and performs no implementation dispatch.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Repository-required bounded helpers may inspect convention or balance Distill, but they do not own lifecycle steps or product mutation.
context: The UX/UI research dispatch is already closed.
Invoke is the one authoring owner.
Future work is one-SWU Task Session execution.

technique_overlays.trigger: The UI groups source-backed records but must not invent membership, semantics or approval.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Reusable core, project profile, UI state, execution evidence, ontology authority and promotion owners remain explicit and separate.

boundaries.contract: Verified requests and baseline are source evidence; they do not implement or promote product behavior.
Project choices are explicit replaceable inputs; core never infers them.
Design-validator-pass permits Plan authoring; Plan evidence and execution remain separate.
Invoke supplies blocked atomic contracts; only a later approved/selected Task Session may admit one mutation unit.
Presentation and browser evidence has authority effect none and cannot promote ontology, release or production state.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke owns this candidate Define, Design and Plan package; Task Session owns one future admitted SWU.
authority.execution: No SWU is executed by this dispatch.
authority.validation: Inventory, Design selector/validator, Dispatch Spec, Distill and scoped package checks.
authority.evidence: Repository sources and candidate authoring/validation receipts.
authority.memory: Inventory and memory are read-only context, not ontology or Plan authority.
authority.promotion: Project, ontology, human-study, release and production owners remain independent.

state_namespaces.owner: Invoke authoring and later declared closeout owner
state_namespaces.write_policy: Define, Design, Plan, validation and explicitly declared closeout only.
Read-only during Invoke; future Task Session writes one exact SWU scope.

state_namespaces.owner: Body War and private authority owners
state_namespaces.write_policy: Read-only; no presentation or evidence mutation.

state_namespaces.owner: Inventory and public Arcanum lifecycle owners
state_namespaces.write_policy: Read-only lookup/capability source; no private transport.

promotion_splits.rule: The selected SWU's scoped owner inputs, Refresh revalidation and Task Session admission are still required; SWU-OEWSN-004 requires OD-04 only.

promotion_splits.target: human, ontology, release or production authority
promotion_splits.rule: Receipt proves one bounded candidate-local automated Body War run only.

promotion_guardrails: No package manifest, external network, ontology mutation, promotion, release or deployment is authored or executed.
Body War remains a replaceable first profile and cannot redefine reusable core semantics.
Owner choices, Plan approval, Task Session admission, runtime evidence, human evidence and production readiness are distinct states.
Private content remains in cyberAlchemy-v2 and is not transported into public Arcanum.
